string.text: Document folder

A thick folder of documents from some laboratory. It contains a wealth of information about experiments, observations and research findings, as well as administrative papers such as technical documentation, invoices, summaries and reports. Extremely valuable information for any faction.\n \n
Notebook

A field notebook of scientific observations and drawings, found with a group of ecologists. Several pages are encrypted. The information inside will certainly interest some factions. The ecologists would surely like it back, but other factions will want it too.\n \n

A thick stack of old papers from some administrative building. Most are worthless, such as payment receipts, routine reports and printouts. There may be useful information or patterns hidden among them, but finding them will take time and patience.\n \n

The notebook contains accounting information, but the entries are encrypted for security. It belongs to the military or another independent faction operating in this area. This document could become a dangerous weapon if it fell into the wrong hands.\n \n
An old notebook, probably found in one of the X-labs or nearby. Scientists will pay well for it, since anything inside could shed light on the true nature of events before the second Emission.\n \n
Document page

A page from a printed military intelligence document. The information is encrypted, as is standard practice for the military when documents are sent without wireless alternatives. It can be decoded by hand or with a special device. It has little value to a non-specialist. Rumor has it that some organized groups have access to military decryption codes. The SBU will surely want this information back, but other factions will be interested too.\n \n

An old page from a laboratory notebook. Some factions may find it interesting, but it is unlikely to be useful for anything else. The handwriting is messy and blurred, and improper storage has made the text even harder to read. Scientists may be interested in this information.\n \n

A separate document page in rather poor condition. It shows some kind of diagram resembling a complex laboratory device. Liquid stains have made most of the printed text unreadable, but it may still be worth something.\n \n

A single page from a shipping manifest, detailing which goods were sent where and in what quantities. It looks new, though it's unclear whether it was printed recently or simply kept in a cool, dry place. Unfortunately, the goods are identified only by codes, though the prices beside them are quite interesting.\n \n

Some kind of correspondence between two coded parties. Neither side is identified beyond two encrypted call signs. Mercenary groups usually pass information this way using one-time pads and dead drops, ensuring complete secrecy and anonymity for everyone involved.\n \n
Old documents
USB flash drive
A USB flash drive found in a briefcase. A common, compact way to store and transport large amounts of information. A computer is required to access the data.\n \n
Note from a briefcase

Flea,
 
If you're reading this, don't give the loot to Boss's men like we planned. That bastard tried to kill us! Only Thief and I got out. Boss thinks that because Boar gave him control of the Cemetery, he's a big shot and can betray his brothers! Take the loot, go to Sultan and hire a few fighters. Then we'll show that son of a bitch his place. I'll meet you by the bridge.
 
Worm
Note from a sniper rifle case

Hey, bro!
 
The guys and I wanted to thank you for saving our asses so many times. We heard your birthday is coming up, so we asked around and got you this new toy. I know you keep complaining that your old SVU is a piece of junk, inaccurate and all that, so we bought you a real sniper rifle. Enjoy it, brother! We'll be back at the Warehouses whenever you want to come by for a drink.
 
Pasha
Note from a coin-operated case

Note from a briefcase

Misha,
 
I'm not coming home. Take this artifact and give it to Sakharov, mention me, and he'll arrange treatment for Mom. Finch's gang cornered me, and one way or another I have to end this.
 
I'm sorry, brother. Tell Zlata I love her.
Note from a survival cache

BROTHERS, I SAW THE LIGHT. IT BURNS THE SOUL. IT BURNS AND IT HURTS. I CAN HEAR IT. IT MUST BE SEALED. WE ARE CURSED. THERE IS NO LIGHT. THERE IS NO HOPE. ONLY PAIN AND SUFFERING. OH GOD, IT HURTS SO MUCH. NO. GET IT AWAY. GET IT AWAY. HELP. I CAN'T. HELP. NO. PLEASE. HELP ME.\n \n
Note from a toolbox

Yuri,
 
I finally found something valuable! I followed your tip about the stash in the Swamps. Took all I could and barely got away. There's still a lot of junk there, so I'm going back. I saw a few bandits hanging around, so I'll take the SVT. Here's your share for now. Hope it brings you luck!
 
Viktor
Note from a weapon crate

Andrey,
 
I swiped this crate from Spooner's warehouse. Since he keeps smoking while on duty, the ammo depot is bound to turn into a fireworks show. Take these F-1 grenades to the tunnel on the Cordon, west of Kuznetsov's post; you'll meet some Loners there with a crate of artifacts. Bring Lentsov and Romanenko—they can be trusted. Once the exchange is done, leave the artifacts where you found this crate.
 
Sergeant Kovalenko
Note from a toolbox

Personal journal of Andrey Petrenko
 
Yesterday was my birthday. I've been living in the Zone for almost a year, give or take, and I go outside for supplies from time to time. I'm starting to like it here. The outside world never showed me much respect, but here I work honestly and my fellow stalkers respect me. There's something strange about this place. It hates technology and violence. In the past year alone, I've cleaned and serviced more weapons here than in ten years as a gunsmith.
Note from a padlocked toolbox

Konstantin,
 
Take these tools to Mangun. The damned Zone eats everything away with rust, and there's only so much you can do with duct tape and fishing line.
 
Mikhail
Note from a survival cache

Patriot,
 
Your current objectives:
 
Meet Shinobi at the designated point Beta Rho Nine Two Five.
Using the disguise supplies, infiltrate point Kappa Oscar. A guard is usually posted outside; use the provided money to get past him.
Hand one package to Shinobi and take another, then deliver it to the fuel tanks at position Charlie. Set the timer for 22 hours.
When finished, meet Shinobi and proceed to extraction point Alpha 4 to report.
Note from a Pelican gun case

Raven,
 
As soon as you find this, take up position on the water tower. That snitch is hiding with Freedom. At 22:00 we'll spook the rat, and he'll probably try to slip past the checkpoint. Take him out before he does, and make sure you get the flash drive from his body. I don't care what happens to his other stuff.
Note from a briefcase
Hey, when you're done with your "business," please close this briefcase and clean up after yourself! If I find those damn magazines again, I'll shove a Fireball up your ass!\n \n
Note from a lead container

Professor Sakharov,
 
Yesterday a stalker nicknamed Windy visited the Mobile Lab and sold us this very strange artifact. He claims it is a "poltergeist entity." We don't know where it came from, and the seller refused to say when asked. The artifact looks like a piece of quartz, but is amorphous, like wet sand. The sample floats while at rest and exerts a weak gravitational pull on small nearby objects, such as pebbles. Our lab lacks the proper equipment, so we are sending you the sample for further analysis.
 
Researcher Nikolai
Note from a secure container

Damn this place! Today Orel ran into one of those damn anomalies while we were fighting off a pack of dogs. A piece of his thigh landed right in my face! We couldn't find his dog tag—the chunks were scattered twenty meters around. Jackal is starting to lose it too; I heard him muttering in his sleep. I hope those TerraGroup bastards we're chasing are rotting in some radioactive ditch already. I signed up to shoot looters and capitalists, not deal with this weird shit. Hopefully I'll get the hell out of here soon.\n \n
Note from an old weapon crate

8 September 2018
 
Damn, man, I'm dead!
Marco just had to run his mouth to that bitch Hip in the village! He bragged that he had a Bison shotgun that could shoot a boar's balls off from 100 meters! She heard us and made a great offer. Then that dumb bastard had to say he'd only sleep with her if she sucked him off! That night we camped by the tunnel entrance, and somehow that bitch found us with a squad of serious hombres! She put her pistol to Marco's junk and shot his damn balls off! She told me to bring her the shotgun or she'd shoot mine off next! Artem decided to run, and Marco is sleeping it off at camp while I'm God knows where making sure that shooter is still here. To hell with this! I'm out! I'll leave the shotgun where it is and hope she finds it before she finds me! I hope her damn client explodes right in her hands.
Note from a lead container

Senior Researcher Pavel,
 
We've made some progress transmuting the "Hourglass" artifact. As expected, placing several artifacts in the "Jelly" anomaly worked. But adding a "Flash" artifact afterward caused an unexpectedly sharp energy surge. Trainee Andreychuk was knocked onto his back, and one of our computers got splashed with liquid. Overall, staff and equipment suffered only minor damage. Unfortunately, our suits and field gear now reek of something awful, and the smell won't go away! We'll order new equipment and sell our old suits on the black market.
Until we perfect the formula, I'll leave one of the transmutation ingredients here. I don't want to risk it again.
 
Researcher Nikolai
Note from a survival cache

Vodka! You feel stronger!
Vodka! Say "No" to a bad mood!
Vodka! Your eyes sparkle!
Vodka! You're a real man!
Vodka! Wipes away your tears!
Vodka! Gets rid of your fears!
Vodka! Everything is wonderful!
Yes, vodka!
